# Written by sqlgen::portable::golden; never edited by hand.

## ansi: select
all columns, first page
  sql: "SELECT \"id\", \"name\", \"age\", \"price\", \"payload\", \"data\", \"geom\", \"Odd \"\"Name\"\" ]\", \"created\"\nFROM \"app\".\"users\" ORDER BY \"id\" ASC\nLIMIT 100 OFFSET 0"
two columns, third page
  sql: "SELECT \"name\", \"geom\"\nFROM \"app\".\"users\" ORDER BY \"id\" ASC\nLIMIT 50 OFFSET 200"
sorted with NULLs first and last
  sql: "SELECT \"id\", \"name\", \"age\", \"price\", \"payload\", \"data\", \"geom\", \"Odd \"\"Name\"\" ]\", \"created\"\nFROM \"app\".\"users\" ORDER BY \"name\" DESC NULLS FIRST, \"age\" ASC NULLS LAST, \"price\" ASC\nLIMIT 100 OFFSET 0"
no primary key, rowid identity asked
  sql: "SELECT \"id\", \"name\", \"age\", \"price\", \"payload\", \"data\", \"geom\", \"Odd \"\"Name\"\" ]\", \"created\"\nFROM \"app\".\"users\"\nLIMIT 100 OFFSET 0"
sort on an unknown column
  error INVALID_INPUT "unknown column \"nope\""
no columns
  error INVALID_INPUT "no columns to select"

## tsql: select
all columns, first page
  sql: "SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [id]) AS [id], CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [name]) AS [name], CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [age]) AS [age], CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [price]) AS [price], CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [payload]) AS [payload], [data], [geom].STAsText() AS [geom], CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [Odd \"Name\" ]]]) AS [Odd \"Name\" ]]], CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [created]) AS [created]\nFROM [app].[users] ORDER BY [id] ASC\nOFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 100 ROWS ONLY"
two columns, third page
  sql: "SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [name]) AS [name], [geom].STAsText() AS [geom]\nFROM [app].[users] ORDER BY [id] ASC\nOFFSET 200 ROWS FETCH NEXT 50 ROWS ONLY"
sorted with NULLs first and last
  sql: "SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [id]) AS [id], CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [name]) AS [name], CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [age]) AS [age], CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [price]) AS [price], CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [payload]) AS [payload], [data], [geom].STAsText() AS [geom], CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [Odd \"Name\" ]]]) AS [Odd \"Name\" ]]], CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [created]) AS [created]\nFROM [app].[users] ORDER BY CASE WHEN [name] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, [name] DESC, CASE WHEN [age] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, [age] ASC, [price] ASC\nOFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 100 ROWS ONLY"
no primary key, rowid identity asked
  sql: "SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [id]) AS [id], CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [name]) AS [name], CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [age]) AS [age], CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [price]) AS [price], CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [payload]) AS [payload], [data], [geom].STAsText() AS [geom], CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [Odd \"Name\" ]]]) AS [Odd \"Name\" ]]], CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [created]) AS [created]\nFROM [app].[users] ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)\nOFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 100 ROWS ONLY"
sort on an unknown column
  error INVALID_INPUT "unknown column \"nope\""
no columns
  error INVALID_INPUT "no columns to select"

## variants: paging and limit one
LimitOffset, no order, offset 0
  sql: "SELECT \"id\", \"name\", \"age\", \"price\", \"payload\", \"data\", \"geom\", \"Odd \"\"Name\"\" ]\", \"created\"\nFROM \"app\".\"users\"\nLIMIT 100 OFFSET 0"
LimitOffset, no order, offset 100
  sql: "SELECT \"id\", \"name\", \"age\", \"price\", \"payload\", \"data\", \"geom\", \"Odd \"\"Name\"\" ]\", \"created\"\nFROM \"app\".\"users\"\nLIMIT 100 OFFSET 100"
OffsetFetch, no order, offset 0
  sql: "SELECT \"id\", \"name\", \"age\", \"price\", \"payload\", \"data\", \"geom\", \"Odd \"\"Name\"\" ]\", \"created\"\nFROM \"app\".\"users\" ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)\nOFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 100 ROWS ONLY"
OffsetFetch, no order, offset 100
  sql: "SELECT \"id\", \"name\", \"age\", \"price\", \"payload\", \"data\", \"geom\", \"Odd \"\"Name\"\" ]\", \"created\"\nFROM \"app\".\"users\" ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)\nOFFSET 100 ROWS FETCH NEXT 100 ROWS ONLY"
LimitOnly, no order, offset 0
  sql: "SELECT \"id\", \"name\", \"age\", \"price\", \"payload\", \"data\", \"geom\", \"Odd \"\"Name\"\" ]\", \"created\"\nFROM \"app\".\"users\"\nLIMIT 100"
LimitOnly, no order, offset 100
  error UNSUPPORTED "unsupported: ANSI test cannot skip rows: only the first page can be read this way"
limit one: Limit
  sql: "SELECT \"age\" FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE \"id\" = ? LIMIT 1"
  params: [{"t":"int","v":7}]
  preview: "SELECT \"age\" FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE \"id\" = 7 LIMIT 1"
limit one: Top
  sql: "SELECT TOP (1) CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [age]) FROM [app].[users] WHERE [id] = @P1"
  params: [{"t":"int","v":7}]
  preview: "SELECT TOP (1) CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [age]) FROM [app].[users] WHERE [id] = 7"

## variants: NULL ordering
Native
  sql: "SELECT \"id\", \"name\", \"age\", \"price\", \"payload\", \"data\", \"geom\", \"Odd \"\"Name\"\" ]\", \"created\"\nFROM \"app\".\"users\" ORDER BY \"name\" ASC NULLS LAST\nLIMIT 100 OFFSET 0"
NullFlag
  sql: "SELECT \"id\", \"name\", \"age\", \"price\", \"payload\", \"data\", \"geom\", \"Odd \"\"Name\"\" ]\", \"created\"\nFROM \"app\".\"users\" ORDER BY CASE WHEN \"name\" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, \"name\" ASC\nLIMIT 100 OFFSET 0"
Unsupported
  error INVALID_INPUT "ANSI test cannot sort NULLs first or last"

## variants: case-insensitive matching
Ilike: containsCase
  sql: "SELECT count(*) FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE CAST(\"name\" AS VARCHAR) ILIKE ? ESCAPE '!'"
  params: [{"t":"text","v":"%50!%!_off[x]!!\\%"}]
  preview: "SELECT count(*) FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE CAST(\"name\" AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '%50!%!_off[x]!!\\%' ESCAPE '!'"
Ilike: ilike
  sql: "SELECT count(*) FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE CAST(\"name\" AS VARCHAR) ILIKE ?"
  params: [{"t":"text","v":"%bo_b%"}]
  preview: "SELECT count(*) FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE CAST(\"name\" AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '%bo_b%'"
Ilike: contains
  sql: "SELECT count(*) FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE CAST(\"name\" AS VARCHAR) LIKE ? ESCAPE '!'"
  params: [{"t":"text","v":"%50!%!_off[x]!!\\%"}]
  preview: "SELECT count(*) FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE CAST(\"name\" AS VARCHAR) LIKE '%50!%!_off[x]!!\\%' ESCAPE '!'"
LowerLike: containsCase
  sql: "SELECT count(*) FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE LOWER(CAST(\"name\" AS VARCHAR)) LIKE LOWER(?) ESCAPE '!'"
  params: [{"t":"text","v":"%50!%!_off[x]!!\\%"}]
  preview: "SELECT count(*) FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE LOWER(CAST(\"name\" AS VARCHAR)) LIKE LOWER('%50!%!_off[x]!!\\%') ESCAPE '!'"
LowerLike: ilike
  sql: "SELECT count(*) FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE LOWER(CAST(\"name\" AS VARCHAR)) LIKE LOWER(?)"
  params: [{"t":"text","v":"%bo_b%"}]
  preview: "SELECT count(*) FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE LOWER(CAST(\"name\" AS VARCHAR)) LIKE LOWER('%bo_b%')"
LowerLike: contains
  sql: "SELECT count(*) FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE CAST(\"name\" AS VARCHAR) LIKE ? ESCAPE '!'"
  params: [{"t":"text","v":"%50!%!_off[x]!!\\%"}]
  preview: "SELECT count(*) FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE CAST(\"name\" AS VARCHAR) LIKE '%50!%!_off[x]!!\\%' ESCAPE '!'"
Unsupported: containsCase
  error INVALID_INPUT "ANSI test has no case-insensitive match"
Unsupported: ilike
  error INVALID_INPUT "ANSI test has no case-insensitive match"
Unsupported: contains
  sql: "SELECT count(*) FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE CAST(\"name\" AS VARCHAR) LIKE ? ESCAPE '!'"
  params: [{"t":"text","v":"%50!%!_off[x]!!\\%"}]
  preview: "SELECT count(*) FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE CAST(\"name\" AS VARCHAR) LIKE '%50!%!_off[x]!!\\%' ESCAPE '!'"
LIKE without an ESCAPE clause
  sql: "SELECT count(*) FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE CAST(\"name\" AS VARCHAR) LIKE ?"
  params: [{"t":"text","v":"50\\%\\\\%"}]
  preview: "SELECT count(*) FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE CAST(\"name\" AS VARCHAR) LIKE '50\\%\\\\%'"

## variants: rowid locator
select with rowid
  sql: "SELECT \"id\", \"name\", \"age\", \"price\", \"payload\", \"data\", \"geom\", \"Odd \"\"Name\"\" ]\", \"created\", rowid AS \"_tabler_rowid\"\nFROM \"app\".\"users\" ORDER BY rowid ASC\nLIMIT 100 OFFSET 0"
fetch by rowid
  sql: "SELECT \"name\" FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE rowid = ? LIMIT 1"
  params: [{"t":"int","v":9}]
  preview: "SELECT \"name\" FROM \"app\".\"users\" WHERE rowid = 9 LIMIT 1"

## injection
ansi
  sql: "SELECT \"a\"\"b]c\"\nFROM \"s\"\"]`\".\"t\"\"; DROP TABLE x; --]\"\nWHERE \"a\"\"b]c\" = ?\nLIMIT 100 OFFSET 0"
  params: [{"t":"text","v":"1' OR '1'='1"}]
  preview: "SELECT \"a\"\"b]c\"\nFROM \"s\"\"]`\".\"t\"\"; DROP TABLE x; --]\"\nWHERE \"a\"\"b]c\" = '1'' OR ''1''=''1'\nLIMIT 100 OFFSET 0"
tsql
  sql: "SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [a\"b]]c]) AS [a\"b]]c]\nFROM [s\"]]`].[t\"; DROP TABLE x; --]]]\nWHERE [a\"b]]c] = @P1 ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)\nOFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 100 ROWS ONLY"
  params: [{"t":"text","v":"1' OR '1'='1"}]
  preview: "SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), [a\"b]]c]) AS [a\"b]]c]\nFROM [s\"]]`].[t\"; DROP TABLE x; --]]]\nWHERE [a\"b]]c] = N'1'' OR ''1''=''1' ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)\nOFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 100 ROWS ONLY"
